book.name: 2Qorontoose Asaas
book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoose Asaas Xaafida Nam7anththo Kiita

content: Nuni Xoossara ooththizayta gidida mala intte ekkida Xoossa kiyateththaa coo mela ashshofte gishe nu inttena woossoos.
Xoossi, «Tani taas giigida gallas nena siyadis! Attiza gallas ta nena maaddadis!» giza gishshas lo7o wodey hekko ha7i! Ateththa gallassika ha7ikko!
Nu oosoy leqettontta mala ay wodekka oonaska nuni dhuphe gidokko.
Hessafe aaththidi waayenne meto un7oka dandayan Xoossas ooththiza asata mala ay ogerakka nunateththaa aaththi immoos.
Nuni Xoossas ooththizayta gididayssa bessizay garafeteththan, qasheteththan, hirgan, daaburi ooson, dhisko dhayoninne gafanna.
Hessaththoka geeshshateththan, erateththan, dandayan, kiyateththan, Xillo Ayana kaaloninne qoodheppe qommon gidontta siiqon,
tuma qaalaninne Xoossa wolqqanna; nu Izan gede oli xooniza ola miishshinne kametti attiza gondalley xilloteththa.
Bonchchos gidiin woykko kawushshas, qoodhettanaas woykko galatanaas nuni giigettidayta; nuni tumanchchata shin ase baleththizayta geetettidos.
Nuni erettidayta shin erettonttayta gididos; istti hayqqidaytakko gishin nuni paxa doos; asay nuna bukki bukkiinkka nu hayqqibeekko.
Muuzoy nuna gakkikokka ubba wode ufayettoos; nuni manqoko shin daro manqota dure kessoos; nuus aykkoyka bayndayta shin wurikka nuus dees.
Intteno Qorontoosen dizaytoo! Ta kase inttes qonccen yootadis; nuni nu wozina inttena ubbaa bessidos.
Intte qasse nuna intte siiqo bessanaas uuzettideta attiin nu inttena nu siiqo bessanaas uuzettibeekko.
Aaway ba naas yootiza mala tanikka inttes ane yootays; nuni nu wozina keehi doydi nu qofaa inttes qonccisoyssaththo intteka nuus hessaththo qonccisite.
Ammanonttaytara Zuppeteth Ago
Ammanontta asara giigay baynda issifeteththan oykettofte; xilloteththinne nagaray waani issifettanaas dandayzee? Poo7oynne dhumay issife waani daana dandayzee?
Kirstoosinne Daabulosi
waani gaagganaas dandayzoo? Ammanizaadey ammanonttaadera aazan laggetanaas dandayzee?
Xoossa Woosa Keeththas eeqatara aaza gaagoy dizee? Xoossika,
Goday, «Intte istta giddofe
gees Ubbaa dandayza Goday.

footnotes.text: Daabulosi: Daabulosi Girike qaalara, «Belyal» woykko «Belyar» geetettees; Ibraaweta qaalara, «Bel7ol» geetettees. Birsheththay go7ay bayndayssa [ayfey bayndayssa] woykko wogay bayndayssa guussa.
